'''Cecilia Clementi''' is an Italian-American scientist who specialises in the simulation of biomolecules. She is a Professor of Theoretical and Computational Biophysics at the [[Free University of Berlin]]. She was previously a Professor of Chemistry at the [[Rice University]] and co-director of the [[National Science Foundation]] Molecular Sciences Software Institute. From 2017 to 2019, she held an [[Einstein Foundation]] fellowship.

== Early life and education ==
Clementi is from [[Italy]]. She studied physics at the [[University of Florence]], where she earned her [[Laurea]] in 1995. After graduating in physics, Clementi moved to the [[International School for Advanced Studies]] for her doctoral degree.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Cecilia Clementi {{!}} The People of Rice {{!}} Rice University|url=https://profiles.rice.edu/faculty/cecilia-clementi|access-date=2020-10-15|website=profiles.rice.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Cecilia Clementi - AMLD EPFL 2020|url=https://appliedmldays.org/speakers/cecilia-clementi|access-date=2020-10-15|website=appliedmldays.org}}</ref> Clementi was a postdoctoral fellow at the [[University of California, San Diego]], where she was part of the La Jolla Interfaces in Science programme.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|title=» Congratulations to physicist Cecilia Clementi SISSA Alumni Society|url=https://alumni.sissa.it/congratulations-to-physicist-cecilia-clementi/|access-date=2020-10-15|language=en-US}}</ref> After completing her postdoctoral research Clementi was appointed as an assistant professor at [[Rice University]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research and career ==
In 2009 Clementi was made a Professor of Chemistry at Rice University.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Cecilia Clementi, Einstein Foundation Berlin|url=https://www.einsteinfoundation.de/en/fellows-projects/einstein-fellows-professors/einstein-strategic-professorship/cecilia-clementi/ |access-date=2023-07-26|website=einsteinfoundation.de|language=en,de}}</ref> Her research considers the simulation of complex biophysical processes using large-scale data sets.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Clementi Research Group|url=https://clementiresearch.rice.edu/|access-date=2020-10-15|website=clementiresearch.rice.edu}}</ref> She specializes in [[Coarse-grained modeling|coarse-grain modeling]] of macromolecular systems. In 2016, Clementi was made co-director of the [[National Science Foundation]] Molecular Sciences Software Institute.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=Prof. Dr. Cecilia Clementi {{!}} SFB TRR186 Heidelberg - Berlin |url=https://trr186.uni-heidelberg.de/en/ceciliaclementi|access-date=2023-07-26|website=trr186.uni-heidelberg.de}}</ref>

Clementi joined the [[Free University of Berlin]] in 2017 as an [[Einstein Foundation]] fellow,<ref name=":1"/> during which she focused on the multi-scale modelling of biophysical systems in an effort to better understand cellular functions.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-09-20|title=Multiscale Modeling of Biophysical Systems|url=https://www.mi.fu-berlin.de/en/math/groups/ag-clementi/index.html|access-date=2020-10-15|website=www.mi.fu-berlin.de|language=en}}</ref> She was the first Einstein Foundation fellow to be appointed to their Strategic Professorships Program.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-11-19|title=Freie Universität Berlin Appoints Prominent Physicist Cecilia Clementi as Part of the Einstein Strategic Professorships Program|url=https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/presse/informationen/fup/2019/fup_19_353-clementi-einstein-profil-professur/index.html|access-date=2020-10-15|website=www.fu-berlin.de|language=en}}</ref>

Clementi was made a Professor of Physics at the Free University of Berlin in June 2020.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-06-05|title=Professor Cecilia Clementi starts her work at Freie Universität|url=https://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/news/2020-cecilia-clementi.html|access-date=2020-10-15|website=www.physik.fu-berlin.de|language=en}}</ref>

More recently, Clementi has collaborated with others to use a machine-learning model to navigate protein landscapes. <ref name=":3">{{Cite journal |last1=Charron |first1=Nicholas E. |last2=Bonneau |first2=Klara |last3=Pasos-Trejo |first3=Aldo S. |last4=Guljas |first4=Andrea |last5=Chen |first5=Yaoyi |last6=Musil |first6=Félix |last7=Venturin |first7=Jacopo |last8=Gusew |first8=Daria |last9=Zaporozhets |first9=Iryna |last10=Krämer |first10=Andreas |last11=Templeton |first11=Clark |last12=Kelkar |first12=Atharva |last13=Durumeric |first13=Aleksander E. P. |last14=Olsson |first14=Simon |last15=Pérez |first15=Adrià |date=August 2025 |title=Navigating protein landscapes with a machine-learned transferable coarse-grained model |journal=Nature Chemistry |language=en |volume=17 |issue=8 |pages=1284–1292 |doi=10.1038/s41557-025-01874-0 |pmid=40681718 |pmc=12313527 |arxiv=2310.18278 |bibcode=2025NatCh..17.1284C |issn=1755-4349}}</ref>

== Underwater photography ==
